candidates.topic: Sun at 29° Virgo — Anaretic Degree Before Libra
candidates.teaser: The Sun is sitting at the most unstable degree in the zodiac right now — and most people have no idea what that means for them.
candidates.video_title: Sun at 29° Virgo — The Most Urgent Degree
candidates.video_description: The Sun is at 29° Virgo — the anaretic degree — a point astrologers call the crisis degree. It's the final breath before a major identity shift into Libra season. Here's what that pressure actually means.
candidates.script: The Sun is at 29° Virgo right now — and in astrology, 29 degrees is called the crisis degree, the point of no return. Every planet at 29° is racing to finish unfinished business before it crosses into a completely different energy. That means this is your last window to audit, fix, and refine before Libra season flips the entire focus from self-improvement to relationships. What have you been avoiding? The Sun won't wait much longer.

candidates.topic: Waxing Gibbous Moon in Aquarius — Almost Full
candidates.teaser: The Moon is almost full — and it's sitting in Aquarius, one of the most emotionally detached signs in the zodiac. That tension is not an accident.
candidates.video_title: Waxing Gibbous Moon in Aquarius — The Pressure Builds
candidates.video_description: The Moon is in a Waxing Gibbous phase in Aquarius — almost full, building toward peak illumination. Astrologers read this as a moment of mounting pressure where what you've been building demands to be seen. Aquarius adds a cold, detached lens.
candidates.script: The Moon is almost full right now — and it's in Aquarius, the sign that would rather analyze feelings than feel them. In astrology, the Waxing Gibbous phase is the moment right before peak pressure, when everything you've been building is about to crack open. But with the Moon in Aquarius, the catch is this: you'll intellectualize what you should be releasing. The question isn't what you think about it. It's what you actually feel. Can you tell the difference?

candidates.topic: Mercury in Libra Approaching Retrograde Shadow
candidates.teaser: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but it's already creeping toward the zone that will matter most when it goes backward in October.
candidates.video_title: Mercury in Libra — The Shadow Before the Storm
candidates.video_description: Mercury is at 19° Libra right now, moving toward its retrograde shadow zone ahead of the October 24 retrograde. Astrologers say the shadow period is when the real disruptions quietly begin — in communication, decisions, and relationships.
candidates.script: Mercury isn't retrograde yet — but mark your calendar: October 24th, it goes backward in Libra. Right now at 19° Libra, Mercury is already approaching the shadow zone, which means the miscommunications, the hesitation, the second-guessing in your relationships? That's already starting. Astrologers call this the pre-shadow — the quiet warning before the chaos. If a conversation has been sitting unfinished, Libra energy is pushing you to have it now, before Mercury locks everything in reverse.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 1st House — The Mask You Were Born With
candidates.teaser: Your rising sign gets all the attention — but most people don't realize it's just the beginning of what your 1st house is actually doing.
candidates.video_title: The 1st House — It's Not Just Your Rising Sign
candidates.video_description: The 1st house in astrology is the house of self, identity, and first impressions — but it's more than your rising sign. Any planet sitting inside it completely rewrites how you show up in the world. Most people never check what's in there.
candidates.script: Your rising sign is not your personality — it's your mask, the first impression your chart hands the world before you even speak. But here's what most people miss: whatever planet sits inside your 1st house completely overrides that mask. A Libra rising with Mars in the 1st house doesn't read as peaceful — they read as driven, intense, maybe even aggressive. The rising sign is the door. The planets inside are who's actually standing there. Have you checked what's inside yours?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries Opposite Venus in Scorpio
candidates.teaser: Two of the most serious planets in astrology are pulling against each other right now — and it's aimed directly at your closest relationships.
candidates.video_title: Saturn in Aries vs Venus in Scorpio — Relationship Tension
candidates.video_description: Saturn retrograde at 12° Aries is sitting in opposition to Venus at 6° Scorpio — two signs that couldn't be more different in how they handle love and commitment. In astrology, this tension forces a reckoning between what you want and what's actually sustainable.
candidates.script: Saturn retrograde is in Aries. Venus is in Scorpio. These two are pulling in opposite directions right now, and astrologers read that as a direct pressure point in relationships. Saturn in Aries demands independence, rules, and hard limits. Venus in Scorpio wants total merger, depth, and no walls. The tension between them forces one question: are the structures in your relationship actually built on what you both want — or just on what you've been afraid to say out loud?
